dimensions.detail: The skill enables creating, scheduling, and uploading Telegram posts via the Publora API; public or group posting is high-impact but directly matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains straightforward setup steps and API examples, with no hidden role changes, prompt manipulation, unrelated automation, destructive actions, or local data harvesting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The bundle contains only a markdown SKILL.md file and no executable scripts, install hooks, packages, or background components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use requires a Publora API key, Telegram bot token, and Telegram channel or group permissions; these are sensitive but proportionate for publishing and scheduling Telegram content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no local persistence in the skill, but adding a Telegram bot as an administrator creates ongoing posting authority until the user revokes it.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help publish or schedule Telegram posts through Publora. Protect the Publora API key and Telegram bot token, grant the bot only the minimum channel or group permissions needed, and review destination, content, media, and scheduled time before creating posts.
llm.summary: This instruction-only skill helps post or schedule Telegram content through Publora, and its sensitive posting permissions are disclosed and fit that purpose.
